title: Ljunggren--Jacobsthal and Bailey-Type Congruences for Rectangular Gaussian Binomial Coefficients
summary: Motivated by the polynomial form of Kalinin's Gaussian analogue of Wolstenholme's theorem, following Kalinin, we study a two-dimensional factorial ratio over the Gaussian integers, which we call the rectangular Gaussian binomial coefficient. For a rational prime $p\equiv 3\pmod 4$, we first prove that these coefficients are $p$-integral. Our main result is a Ljunggren--Jacobsthal-type supercongruence: for $p>5$ and every $k\geq 1$, simultaneous dilation of all four parameters by $p^k$ changes the coefficient by a multiple of $p^{3k}$.
